title: Iterated stage construction
statement: For a sequence $N$ of finite oracle Turing machines over Boolean symbols, define stage data recursively by starting with empty positive set and bound $0$ at stage $0$, then obtaining stage $i+1$ by applying the stage update at index $i$ to stage $i$.
